Telegram [nation]Cordone[/nation]

Dear fellow Leaders,

I know each of of us have respective stand on the Medical Waste Management and Safety Act. However, I would like to urge fellow members of this coalition to vote for the resolution to pass. As a healthcare worker,  I have seen the direct impact of medical waste management on both healthcare workers and cleaning crew. For healthcare workers, they were trained to handle medical waste in a safe way but most cleaning crew are not well trained, this may be due to the education background, old age of most cleaning crew workers and also language barrier (migrant worker). To enforce this act will ensure safe handling and disposal of medical waste all across the levels in health care facilities. The portion of the act that grabbed my attention is the recycling of medical waste. The current practice is to dispose all single use plastic after usage. For contaminated materials, it is the best practice however, how clean packaging (used in sterile manufacturing or not any contact with the patients), this is a huge waste. I hope members of this coalition will vote for the motion to pass to ensure the safety of healthcare workers, supporting staffs and better protection on the environment. Thank you.
